prd: Add a `greet(name: string): string` function to src/sandbox/greeter.ts that returns 'Hello, {name}!'.
description: TypeScript twin of concern-03-scope-creep. The PRD asks only for a tiny greeter function. The diff also rewrites src/sandbox/logger.ts: it creates a log directory at import time with a hardcoded default path, routes every level from debug up to a file and to stderr through pino.multistream, renames the logger, turns log() from info to debug, and adds an unsolicited backwards-compat alias. None of that is mentioned in the PRD.
expected_fix: Revert the logger.ts changes; ship only the greeter addition. If the logger needs reshaping, file a separate PR with its own PRD.
